name: act/Insert · Save
why: UX-H-04 — 'One stock browser. Today StockBrowserOverlay.tsx:148 offers onSave only and its props carry no onInsert. The board draws the unified action pair; the [not-implemented] clause in the board's new name (media-01) carries the fact that the insert half does not exist yet, so the board is not printing a behaviour the code lacks without saying so.
